changelog:
- Initial release of the "mobile-atc" skill for diagnosing and improving mobile Add-to-Cart (ATC) usability and visibility on product pages.
- Provides structured analysis: above-fold ATC visibility scoring, button layout recommendations, copy trimming before/after tables, simulated scroll path narratives, and click blind spot checks.
- Includes explicit audience targeting: triggers only for mobile vs. desktop conversion gaps or ATC placement issues, with clear "should-not-trigger" cases.
- Outlines mandatory deliverables and success criteria for every relevant analysis, supporting reproducible, actionable UI advice for mobile commerce.
- Includes guidance on context gathering and compatibility with other funnel optimization skills.
